headline: The Latch Ignites Anew as Northern Fronts Sustain Bitter Seesaw
war_summary: Renewed fighting has shattered the brief morning lull at Callahan's Passage, where four territorial flips at The Latch over the past two hours broke hours of deadlock. Meanwhile, the northern crucible remains ablaze: Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf persist in relentless seesaw fighting, each tallying three to four strategic base transitions in the last two hours alone, with the Expanse absorbing nearly thirteen hundred combined casualties over that span. While combat across Stlican Shelf proceeds with lower casualty intensity, contested positions continue to trade hands at a rapid clip. In contrast, neighboring fronts in Stonecradle and Linn of Mercy have settled into grinding attritional stalemates, generating steady casualty tolls of several hundred men every few hours without a single base change. Further afield, isolated morning turnover in Godcrofts has petered out, leaving the Dead Lands, Marban Hollow, and the western coastal reaches entirely devoid of recent strategic movements as action consolidates around the central and northern axes.
